description_full: ATRenew Inc., together with its subsidiaries, sell pre-owned consumer electronics through its online platforms and other channels in the People's Republic of China. It provides services to third-party merchants to sell the products through its platforms. ATRenew Inc. was formerly known as AiHuiShou International Co. Ltd. and changed its name to ATRenew Inc. November 2021. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

financial_summary: ATRenew Inc. is a small-cap consumer cyclical business with a $899M market cap.
Returns on capital run at -9% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
The company is burning through $84M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
Accruals are elevated at +12.6% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 76× is fortress-like.
Shareholder yield of 4.0% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 9.7% of the shares.
